snippet.title: Sleepover : reWake - 'Afraid' (Official Opening Video)
snippet.description:
#SleepoverReWake #BLits #Afraid

A heartfelt remake of the classic BL / Gay Visual Novel - 'Sleepover: reWake'!
Follow the short story of Kano and Aki, two best friends who have drifted apart over the years. Help Kano navigate the two's changed relationship, and create a special bond with Aki to last forever.

One night is all it takes!

Now available for purchase on the BLits Website, Steam and Itch.io - get your copy at the links below:

VIDEO CREDITS:
Theme Song Title: 'Afraid'
Composed by: KENO
Vocals by: Kazou
Lyrics by: KENO
Opening Video Animation by: Howl
